import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score, train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline, make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler

churn = pd.read_csv("churn.csv")
X = churn.drop(columns=["customer_id", "churned"])
y = churn["churned"]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
numeric = ["tenure_days", "orders", "total_spent", "avg_order_value",
           "days_since_last_order", "used_coupon", "support_tickets", "mobile_share"]

# A customer the training data never prepared you for
new_customer = pd.DataFrame([{
    "country": "France", "segment": "government", "tenure_days": 200, "orders": 2,
    "total_spent": 150.0, "avg_order_value": 75.0, "days_since_last_order": 100,
    "used_coupon": 0, "support_tickets": 0, "avg_satisfaction": np.nan, "mobile_share": 0.5}])

preprocess = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", StandardScaler(), numeric),
    ("sat", make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy="median", add_indicator=True), StandardScaler()),
     ["avg_satisfaction"]),
    ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), ["segment"]),
])
pipe = Pipeline([("prep", preprocess), ("model", LogisticRegression())])
pipe.fit(X_train, y_train)

cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_auc = cross_val_score(pipe, X_train, y_train, cv=cv, scoring="roc_auc").mean()

new_prob = pipe.predict_proba(new_customer)[0, 1]
print(round(cv_auc, 3), round(new_prob, 3))

checks.test: cv_auc is not None and 0.75 < float(cv_auc) < 0.85
new_prob is not None and 0.0 < float(new_prob) < 1.0 and abs(float(new_prob) - float(pipe.predict_proba(new_customer)[0, 1])) < 1e-9
